title: Arrival: a task-based English game
audience: Adult and older-teen English learners at CEFR A2 working towards B1
summary: Just arrived in a new city: buy a ticket, order lunch with a nut allergy, ask a pharmacist for help and fix a hostel booking, in English. Branching dialogues with feedback, repair phrases and a phrasebook. Speech input is optional and off by default.
contentNotes: The pharmacy task is language practice only, not medical advice.

poster.alt: A station help desk under a glass roof: a staff member behind a blue desk, a ticket machine showing CARD NOT ACCEPTED, and a departures board listing the 10:15 to Seaview from platform 4.
